output_list.criticism: The mint function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The totalSupply + value <= TOKEN_LIMIT check is bypassed if value is crafted to overflow.
The transfer function allows the owner to transfer tokens to any address, including 0x0, causing a loss of funds.
The transferFrom function allows any spender to transfer funds from the caller's account, also exposing the spender to the loss of funds.
The approve function allows any spender to transfer funds from the caller's account, also exposing the spender to the loss of funds.
The migrate function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The value <= balances[msg.sender] check is bypassed if value is crafted to overflow.
